question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

A _______ table discussion took place between the heads of states.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"circle"** refers to a round shape or a group of people with shared interests. (वृत्त)

 
 
• **Example: **We sat in a** circle** and discussed our plans for the weekend.
 
 
 
• **"round" **refers to a shape that is circular or it can also mean a series of events or activities. In the context of discussions, it implies an open and equal participation format. (गोल)
 
 
• **Example: **A** round **table discussion was organized to address the community issues.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word to complete the sentence is **'round'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Circle **(वृत्त): A round shape or a group of people with shared interests.

 
 
• **Example:** She drew a perfect circle on the board.
 
 
 
• **Centre **(केंद्र): The middle point of a circle or an important area of focus.
 
 
• **Example: **The city center is always bustling with activity.
 
 
 
• **Rounded** (गोलाकार): Having a smooth, curved surface.
 
 
• **Example:** The edges of the table were rounded for safety.
